source_name: Ministerstvo investícií, regionálneho rozvoja a informatizácie SR (MIRRI) — Otvorené údaje / Centrálna dátová kancelária
why_relevant: Governance owner of the SK open-data regime; publishes the rules, quality standards and roadmap that determine what fiscal and statistical bodies must publish. Useful for anticipating future data availability (and for arguing for access when a dataset is missing).
IT vendor page for SK payment-systems work; vendor case studies, service descriptions and local job ads indirectly reveal which SK banks are modernising card/payment platforms.

source_name: Citium Tech – EU PSD2 Register mirror (Slovakia filter)
why_relevant: Third-party reformatting of the EBA PSD2 register with country filters and counts (e.g. an SK authorised-PI count). Useful as a fast cross-check and for spotting register changes, never as the citation of record.

Popular Slovak news/lifestyle site that covers branch and ATM closures bank by bank (e.g. Slovenská sporiteľňa branch/ATM cuts). Low analytical value but a fast tripwire for cash-access shrinkage events at named institutions.

Slovak news portal covering state assessment of the QR-payment rollout and record volumes; captures the political/fiscal framing of cashless adoption (state as promoter of QR payments) that shapes merchant acceptance policy.

Aggregating Slovak news portal that republishes payment-statistics releases (e.g. QR-payment transaction counts and value milestones). Useful as a redundancy layer to catch releases missed on primary desks.

source_name: SBA Educa, s.r.o. — training/exam arm of the association
why_relevant: Association subsidiary running statutory exams for financial intermediaries; exam volumes and syllabi are a weak indirect indicator of distribution-channel size and regulatory focus areas.

source_name: Trading Economics — EU/Slovakia Eurostat-derived internet banking indicator page
why_relevant: Commercial re-publisher of the Eurostat internet-banking series; occasionally surfaces indicator pages faster than the primary and provides quick charts, but is paywalled/licence-restricted for systematic reuse.
